negative_reviews.author: J Len
negative_reviews.text:
our first server didn’t set table for us and then once we sat down didn’t attend to us until flagged down 20 minutes later
Thankfully, Amidu, saved the day by being very attentive, apologised and help fix the orders that had been written down wrong (chicken given to veggies etc)

also on a more positive note, GREAT vegan black garlic tonkotsu ramen. best i’ve had.

negative_reviews.author: Mia
negative_reviews.text:
The first server seated us to our table and took ages to come back and serve us. We had to ask her to take our order because we were waiting for over 20 minutes. She got our order completely wrong and we had the wrong ramen delivered and she also ordered us chicken gyozas instead of veggie (we are vegetarians). She also hadn’t set the table so once the food did arrive, we had to try and find cutlery/napkins ourselves.
Luckily and thankfully, Amidu took over and he helped to rectify things. He was really kind and helpful; great customer service from him!

The food tasted nice but maybe not be the best place for vegans and vegetarians as you may accidentally be given meat.

negative_reviews.author: Mari K
negative_reviews.text: Had lunch here a while ago and was excited because of the raving reviews. Honestly not sure how they got these as the foods was extremely mediocre. Just another influencer spot that has the looks but not the goods. Staff was super lovely but clearly understaffed and a little unsure of how to handle busy periods. London has to stop with these inauthentic, mediocre, money grabbing places and needs to go back to prioritising businesses with unique, original and passion led cuisine.

negative_reviews.author: Marvin Anthony Edmead
negative_reviews.text: This was a bit ‘meh’ to be completely honest. The squid starter was bland and uninteresting. The ramen was good but not good enough considering the range of other options. Sadly, the service was friendly but not attentive enough. We had higher expectations. Too high? Maybe.

negative_reviews.author: manesh Patel
negative_reviews.text: Went there nearly 2 weeks ago for a birthday. Used their 50% off food discount. Atmosphere was pretty good and so was the food. Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.

issues: Pest control has not been carried out as scheduled and the provider needs calling today; visits should be happening at least every couple of months.
Covers rose slightly and spend per head increased on heavy upselling, with sales hitting target and up on the week.
Deliveroo orders are being rejected, most likely because a till update made all steak ramen halal and removed the separate halal steak buttons from the till.
Deliveroo performance itself was clean, with no prep errors, no inaccuracies and all five star ratings.

Labour is projected above the target because the rush is a short one hour window that needs three staff through the afternoon; the target deliberately allows more cover than the leanest option because service quality and the first impression for new customers matter more.
Quiet periods should be used for cleaning compliance and staff tasks, and staff efficiency during steady shifts remains a challenge.
The drinks stock count showed a zero count alongside a large negative variance, recorded while a new head chef was being trained during a period of manager absence.
Two two star reviews came from confusion between the vegan and the vegetarian ramen; the head chef will run back of house training and CCTV was reviewed with the team member involved.

A one star review about a vegan order was investigated against CCTV and the shift logs, and the customer's account of a female member of waiting staff cannot be correct because none were on shift at the time.
A separate one star review, two weeks old, was found sitting in the email spam folder and had never been actioned.
Front of house have been asking for reviews from customers who had a poor experience, which is dragging the score down.
Staffing: a new full time back of house team member has joined, and two team members have resigned, one for another job and one because of a lack of assigned hours.
An assistant general manager was promoted last week on a one month probation with a two week training period, and has not yet accepted a further offer while they see how it goes.
The assistant manager struggled with the floor plan and the pre shift brief when the general manager was absent on the Sunday, and a face to face performance conversation is being held.

A partnership with Shoreditch Town Hall and the Met Police gives a discount on a promo code to anyone showing a Town Hall ID badge or lanyard, and the site has agreed to provide batch made sushi catering for Town Hall weddings, parties and presentations.
Recruitment continues to support restaurant operations.
Region-wide (South England): A standing daily performance target of ten app signups and ten Google reviews per site has been set, with a proposal to gamify it so the teams engage with it.

Region-wide (South England): Front of house sometimes ask for a review from a table that has had a poor experience; staff must read the table and check satisfaction before asking, and management should routinely check in on section status.
Region-wide (South England): Sites must report the status of their envelope returns to the office.
Customers have complained about raw karaage.
Front of house are not separating plates, bowls and food waste, which is slowing the kitchen porter operation.
The greeting is not being delivered consistently, loudly or clearly.
Two team members have still not submitted their resignations and no hours are being assigned to them in the meantime.
The women's toilet locker is outstanding on the maintenance log.
A new full time back of house team member has joined, and an assistant general manager has been placed on a one month probation with two weeks of training before full promotion.
The site is running the Shoreditch Town Hall discount code and the loyalty app is being introduced to guests.
